opportunities.funder: Carnegie Trust for the Universities of Scotland
opportunities.title: Undergraduate Tuition Fee Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Students from low‑income households who are not eligible for government tuition fee support, ordinarily resident in Scotland, enrolled in an undergraduate degree at a Scottish higher education institution for academic year 2026‑27.
opportunities.summary: Provides tuition fee grants up to £1,820 per year for eligible undergraduate students in Scotland for academic year 2026‑27.

opportunities.funder: Carnegie Trust for the Universities of Scotland
opportunities.title: Carnegie Masters Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Students from low‑income Scottish households, ordinarily resident in Scotland, with a place on a taught or research master’s programme beginning in 2026/27.
opportunities.summary: Provides up to £5,000 per year to support eligible postgraduate master’s study in Scotland.
